name: Original Pancake House Vista
notes: 4 photos: 3.jpg is the full in-restaurant printed menu (most complete; used as the primary source for all sections it covers). 1.jpg is a composite of an online/delivery-style menu covering Drinks, Sandwiches, Crepes, Egg Specialties and Pancakes at different (higher) prices; its Crepes/Egg Specialties/Pancakes items duplicate 3.jpg by name so were skipped, and only its Fancy Coffee/Milk Shakes and full Sandwiches section (not present on 3.jpg) were merged in. 2.jpg is a cover page with no prices, skipped. 4.jpg is an older photocopied specials insert whose items and prices all duplicate items already on 3.jpg at lower, stale prices, so it was skipped entirely.
